about.metaTitle: About Photo Spain — Our Story & Mission
about.metaDescription: Photo Spain connects tourists with talented local photographers across Spain. Learn about our mission and why travelers trust us.

theProblem.text: Spain is one of the most photogenic countries in Europe. Madrid's golden light, Barcelona's dramatic riverfront, Toledo's fairytale palaces, the Costa del Sol's raw coastal beauty — it's a photographer's dream. Yet every year, millions of tourists come home with nothing but blurry selfies and awkward "can you take our photo?" shots from strangers.

ourMission.text1: We believe every trip to Spain deserves to be captured beautifully. That's why we created Photo Spain — a platform where travelers can instantly find and book talented local photographers who know the best spots, the perfect timing, and how to make you feel comfortable in front of the camera.

locationsCovered.text: From the streets of Madrid to the cliffs of the Costa del Sol, from La Rioja vineyards to the volcanic Canary Islands — we cover all of Spain.

about.ctaTitle: Ready to capture your Spain story?

founder.alt: Kate Belova, founder of Photo Spain
founder.bio1: Kate Belova is a professional portrait and lifestyle photographer with over 10 years of experience, based in Madrid, Spain. Known for her "soul portrait" style, Kate has a rare ability to make people feel completely at ease in front of the camera — revealing authentic emotions and genuine personality in every frame.
founder.bio2: After years of shooting family and lifestyle sessions across Madrid, Toledo, and Sitges, Kate realized that tourists visiting Spain wanted beautiful photos but finding a trustworthy local photographer was surprisingly hard. She created Photo Spain to solve this — a curated marketplace where every photographer is personally vetted and every session delivers an exceptional experience.

items.q: Do I need to be a professional photographer?
items.a: Yes. We hand-vet every photographer. You should have a strong portfolio, professional equipment, and experience shooting paid sessions. Hobbyists are not accepted.

items.q: Do I need to live in Spain?
items.a: You must be based in Spain or legally able to work here. Most of our photographers live in or near the cities they serve (Madrid, Barcelona, Costa del Sol, etc.).

items.q: How much do you take from each booking?
items.a: We charge a 15% platform fee on each booking (reduced to 10% for Premium plan). You keep the rest. No upfront costs and no subscription required to get started.

items.q: How and when do I get paid?
items.a: Clients pay through Stripe when they book. Your share is transferred to your bank account after the client accepts the delivered photos.
Two ways: (1) Clients browse our catalog and book you directly, and (2) Our concierge team hand-picks photographers for client requests — you just confirm the booking.
Usually 1–3 business days. We review your portfolio, check your identity, and make sure your profile meets our quality standards.

supportPage.subtitle: Everything you need to know about booking, payments, and getting the most out of Photo Spain

cancelReschedule.answer:
Yes. You can cancel or reschedule through your dashboard.

**Cancellation refunds:**
• 7+ days before the shoot — 100% refund
• 3–7 days before — 50% refund
• Less than 3 days — No refund
• No-show — No refund

**Rescheduling:** You get one free reschedule if requested 48+ hours before the session. Rescheduling within 48 hours is at the photographer's discretion. Weather-related rescheduling is always free.

**If the photographer cancels or reschedules:** You always receive a 100% full refund, regardless of timing. If the cancellation happens less than 48 hours before the shoot, Photo Spain will try to find a replacement photographer for you.

photographerCancels.answer:
If you need to cancel, do so through your dashboard as early as possible. The client always receives a 100% refund regardless of timing.

If you cancel less than 48 hours before the shoot, Photo Spain may attempt to find a replacement photographer for the client.

**Important:** Repeated cancellations (3 or more in 3 months) may result in loss of Featured status, reduced search visibility, or account suspension.

externalLinks.answer:
No. Photographers are not allowed to include personal website URLs, social media links (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, etc.), email addresses, or phone numbers anywhere on their profile — including bio, tagline, package descriptions, and portfolio captions.

All communication with clients must go through Photo Spain's built-in messaging system. This protects both parties by keeping conversations documented, payments secure, and disputes resolvable.

Profiles found to contain external links or contact information will be asked to remove them. Repeated violations may result in account suspension.

getStarted.answer:
Getting started is simple:

1. **Create your account** — Sign up and select 'I take photos'
2. **Complete your profile** — Add a photo, cover image, bio, and tagline
3. **Upload your portfolio** — Showcase at least 15–20 of your best shots
4. **Create packages** — Set up 2–3 packages at different price points
5. **Select your locations** — Mark where you're available to shoot
6. **Add your bank details** — The IBAN we transfer your earnings to

Once your profile is complete and approved by our team, you'll appear in search results and can start receiving bookings.

forcesMajeure.answer:
In case of force majeure events — natural disasters, severe weather warnings, pandemics, or other circumstances beyond anyone's control — both parties are entitled to a full refund or free reschedule with no penalties.

Photo Spain will work with both parties to find the best solution.

contactSupport.answer:
You can reach our support team through:

• **Email:** info@photospain.co
• **Dashboard:** Photographers can submit support tickets directly from their dashboard
• **Contact page:** Visit our contact page to send us a message

We aim to respond to all inquiries within 24 hours during business days.

chooseAnyPhotographer.answer:
Yes — the gift card works with any **participating** Photo Spain photographer across Spain. The recipient browses our full catalog in gift mode and books like a normal session. Photographers opt in by default; a small number choose to opt out, and those are simply hidden from the gift catalog.

The recipient has full freedom: pick anyone, anywhere in Spain, any date that works for both of you.
